title: a record's back-reference is no place
line: the 1940 census's residence in 1935 reads Same House, the house of its own residence; a string whose whole words are on the override's list of phrases for the place of another line is rejected as no place, with the reason in its notes and no request to the geocoder

steps.say: the string as the 1940 census record writes it
the resolver run with nothing planted in its cache: a request would reach the network

expect.why: rejected before the geocoder is asked, the reason in the string's notes
no card asks the owner which place Same House is
